description: This source file implements the 'AvailableFilesReport' function, which loads and returns configuration data from a JSON file related to fetcher configuration in the Android Cuttlefish project. It includes logic for locating the configuration file either in the current directory or in the user's home directory, and uses utility functions for file existence checks and environment variable retrieval.

classes.name: FetcherConfig
classes.description: A class representing the fetcher configuration loaded from a JSON file, with a method for loading its data from specified files.

methods.name: FetcherConfig AvailableFilesReport()
methods.description: Returns a FetcherConfig object populated with configuration data loaded from the current directory or the user's home directory in JSON format.
